song.title: Dancing
song.lyrics:
[V1] .D A When you walked across the room . Bm And asked me to dance with you . G You said, "You're the one I choose" . G I couldn't believe it .D A Like you weren't just passing by . Bm No, you looked me in my eyes . G And I found my paradise .Em D Oh, you are my paradise .G I'm not leaving
[C1] . D Even if the sun drops out of the sky . A Even if the stars stop shining at night . Bm Even if the drummer stops keeping the time . G If your hands are in mine, I won't stop dancing . D Dancing on the mountain of a victory . A Dancing through the valley of a broken dream . Bm Dancing on the plains of the in-between . G D If it's you and me, I won't stop dancing
